title: Linear Response for Contracting on Average Iterated Function Systems
summary: Consider the following probabilistic contracting on average iterated function system $$Φ= \left\{f_i (x) = λ_i x + d_i,\;i=1,2 ;\;\; p = \left(\frac{1}{2} , \frac{1}{2}\right) \right\},$$ where the contraction ratios $λ_1 , λ_2$ are such that $0<λ_1<1<λ_2$ and $λ_1λ_2<1$. Denote by $μ_{λ_1,λ_2}$ its stationary measure. We study the differentiability of $$(\heartsuit)\quad\quad\quad\quad\quad λ_1 \mapsto \int_{\mathbb{R}} φ(x) \,dμ_{λ_1,λ_2}(x),$$ where $φ$ is a suitable test function.
